recipe: frozen DINOv2 ViT-L/14 with 4 register tokens, temporally self-supervised on the pre-cleavage window; 3-seed 256x2 distributional head, no TTA
outputIs: log(mean posterior) -- softmax recovers the posterior exactly
unit: hours until first cleavage; from the corpus' own per-frame clock (Gomez timeElapsed), no assumed frame interval
valProtocol: 6-fold grouped CV over patient-slide components, 3 seeds, sealed vault folded in
partsNote: Stored as 3 consecutive byte-range parts because wrangler refuses objects over 300 MiB. Concatenating part0..part2 in order reproduces the file byte for byte; `sha256` is the checksum of the reassembled whole.
heldOutNote: NO held-out estimate exists. The sealed vault was deliberately folded into training on 2026-08-24, so every figure here is cross-validation.
parityNote: parityHoursDelta is |decoded hours| between the fp32 graph and the shipped fp16 one, over the model's own 0-42 h bin range. Measured with the corrected range (shrink_onnx.py previously hardcoded the mouse corpus's r_max=18 and understated every such delta by 2.33x).
ttaNote: TTA-8 measured on this trunk at -0.001 h per embryo (+0.050 at 24k steps, +0.036 at 48k). Deliberately off.
sigmaNote: sigma 0.25, not 1.0. A global sweep called 0.25/0.5/1.0 tied inside the 0.03 h noise floor, but the soft target is a Gaussian truncated at 0, so a wide sigma pushes mass upward where the answer is smallest: at sigma 1.0 the 0-1 h band scored 0.990 h and the model predicted 1.58 h on frames truly 0.59 h out. At 0.25 that band is 0.669 h and the bias 0.63 h, at no overall cost.
intervalNote: The page draws the narrowest span holding `intervalMass` of the posterior, and that span was measured out-of-fold over all 66,573 frames to contain the true time `intervalCoverage` of the time. The two differ enormously because a distributional head trained on soft targets is over-confident: the raw 80%-mass span covers only 28.6%. The MASS is calibrated rather than the width, so the span stays the shape-aware narrowest region and can still straddle a trough on a bimodal posterior. 90% coverage is NOT reachable this way -- even at mass 0.9999 it tops out at 79.2% -- so no higher target is offered.
